in_sanskrit.name: प्रमोद
in_sanskrit.meaning: प्राप्ति (prāpti) + मोद (moda) = प्राप्त मोद (prāpta moda) = प्राप्त होने वाला मद (prāpta hōnē vālā mad) = प्राप्त होने वाला राग (prāpta hōnē vālā rāg) = प्राप्त होने वाला आत्मा (prāpta hōnē vālā ātmā)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has attained happiness or joy within himself.

in_hindi.name: प्रमोद
in_hindi.meaning: प्राप्त होना (prāpta hōna) = प्राप्त हुआ (prāpta huā) = प्राप्त होने वाला (prāpta hōnē vālā)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has attained or achieved something.

in_tamil.name: பிரமோத
in_tamil.meaning: பிரப்பாவது (prabhāvathu) + ஓத் (ōd) = பிரப்பாவத் ஓத் (prabhāvath ōd) = பிரப்பாவத் ஓத்தும் இருக்கும் (prabhāvath ōttum irukkum) = பிரப்பாவத் ஓத்தும் ஆட்டும் (prabhāvath ōttum āttum) = பிரப்பாவத் ஓத்தும் ஆத்மா (prabhāvath ōttum ātmā)
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has attained happiness or joy within himself.

in_telugu.name: ప్రమోద
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has attained or achieved the lordship.

in_marathi.name: प्रमोद
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Creative Energy
in_marathi.long_meaning: प्रमोद हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। प्रमोद: The name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘pramod’ which means ‘to please’ or ‘to move’ and ‘anode’ which means ‘god’. This name signifies the god of creative energy and is often used to describe someone who is dynamic and full of life. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often referred to as ‘प्रमोद’ due to his ability to move and inspire.
